method: All tracked local files compared to GitHub recursive tree Git blob SHA; production artifacts compared byte for byte. This checks source and runtime identity, not release acceptance.

supplementalCaptureSource.algorithm: SHA256(JSON.stringify(sorted Git tracked paths under src public plus index.html package.json package-lock.json vite.config.js, mapped to {path,sha256}))
supplementalCaptureSource.distinction: The capture snapshot covers all 332 tracked src/public/build-root files with path keys. The stamped production hash covers 264 actual runtime build inputs with filename keys. Both independently match the frozen source; they use deliberately different scopes.
